objective: Preserve selected historical Design evidence and one active evidence-backed question across terminal, chat, interruption, and resume, then freeze a complete request for the existing deterministic Design CLI.

prerequisite.current_state: The seed is not an admitted Design and the current Invoke package-closure baseline is not fresh.
required_evidence: fresh selective Invoke package-closure result over exact post-fix bytes
matching independent Wizard Design admission receipt
prerequisite.on_pass: Convert this candidate into invoke.plan-source-v2-authoring-request.v1 bound to the exact Design receipt pair.
prerequisite.on_fail: Remain in Invoke Design; do not create a Plan v2 source or implementation entry.

v1_decisions.question_authorship: The native Invoke agent using Structured Interview Kits authors semantic question content; the CLI validates, queues, persists, and renders it.
v1_decisions.revision_model: absent immutable revision directories plus atomically advanced HEAD.json and expected-revision guards
v1_decisions.finalize_ceiling: freeze one complete authoring request and call only the existing Design check contract

layers.decision_question: Can one evidence-backed question survive interruption and remain identical in terminal and chat?
layers.minimum_working_unit: Two-ref evidence boundary, one classified coverage record, one agent-authored question, one immutable revision, dual rendering, one guarded answer, restart/resume, and one frozen draft field.
exit_evidence: stale revision blocks without HEAD change
terminal and chat bind identical question and coverage identities

layers.decision_question: Does every selected historical evidence ref remain accounted for under drift and concurrent submissions?
layers.minimum_working_unit: Total classifications, bidirectional traceability, dependency invalidation, conflict records, and transaction recovery.

layers.decision_question: Can accepted decisions form a complete request without duplicating the Design producer?
layers.minimum_working_unit: Question queue, JSON Pointer mappings, finalize gates, and existing Design check invocation.
exit_evidence: incomplete or stale fixtures block before output

layers.decision_question: Is the approved behavior portable across canonical and generated Invoke packages without unrelated deltas?
layers.minimum_working_unit: Concrete docs, isolated package canaries, selective sync, and exact parity.
exit_evidence: canonical, Codex, and Claude canaries agree

waves.primary_result: fresh package baseline and admitted Wizard Design
complete request accepted by existing Design check
reviewed package parity and canary closure

swus.behavior: Freeze current inputs and independently admit the Wizard Design.
swus.acceptance: Current stage and admission pair pass without implementation writes.

swus.behavior: Prove the complete durable-question loop from finite evidence boundary through dual rendering, guarded answer, restart/resume, and one frozen draft field.
swus.acceptance: The complete vertical loop passes together and a stale revision cannot advance HEAD.

swus.behavior: Generalize finite historical-evidence coverage, traceability, and drift invalidation.
swus.acceptance: Every denominator ref is classified and traceable, and relevant drift reopens dependents.

swus.behavior: Harden concurrent submissions and interrupted-write recovery.
swus.acceptance: Stale and competing answers cannot overwrite the decision, and an interrupted write preserves the prior revision.

swus.behavior: Queue validated questions and map accepted decisions to exact Design request fields.
swus.acceptance: Mechanical gaps and agent-authored semantic questions produce deterministic request mappings.

swus.behavior: Freeze a complete draft request and call existing Design check.
swus.acceptance: Complete input passes; missing evidence or decisions block.
Canonical and generated canaries agree with no unrelated delta.

gates.pass_condition: Fresh package closure plus current Wizard Design stage and admission PASS.
Vertical proof is deterministic, resumable, revision-safe, and surface-identical.
Coverage, traceability, staleness, conflict, and recovery tests pass.
A complete frozen request passes the existing Design check and incomplete states block.
Canonical and generated canaries pass with exact reviewed parity.

candidate_target_families: reviewed generated Invoke package counterparts after package-closure admission
non_claims: question-answer authority beyond structured user decisions
